The title says it all. Couldn't figure out how to group message mods, so I'm x-posting this to /v/berniesanders as well.
[META] 2 subverses advocating for Bernie: /v/sandersforpresident & /v/berniesanders. Calling on mods to merge for unification. It would be hypocritical to not do so yet claim we are for Bernie, no?

In the long run /v/berniesanders makes more sense. That said, thanks to the huge (couldn't help it!) success of /r/SandersForPresident this subverse makes more sense for now and it's the reason I'm here posting this.

To cross post what I wrote on the /v/berniesanders post:

I disagree. Diversification of tactics and diversification of communities is important to networks like this, and important to Bernie's strategy of dividing the voters along class lines rather than along ideological lines. We need multiple ideologies to work together to make his political strategy work.

If we merge then there will only be one single top mod, who will become the single point of failure if that mod in question goes insane (which is more common than most people think when it comes to digital communities). With two subs we have two points of failure, and through competition they will motivate each other to be better moderators. Also, multiple subverses with multiple moderators will provide slightly different points of view, which is a very good thing.

Just subscribe to both subverses. It's not like the number of subverses you can subscribe to is limited or something. Just put a link to the other sub in the sidebar or as an announcement or something.
